invariants: INV-GOV-CAPSULE-ONE-COMMAND-ONE-CAPSULE: Exactly one sealed task capsule is produced per executed command.
INV-GOV-CAPSULE-SEAL-VERIFIABILITY: The cryptographic seal must be deterministically verifiable across all environments.

provisions.statement: Capsule payload must be serialized using RFC-8785 canonical JSON prior to SHA-256 computation.
Persisted task capsules must have seal.status = "SEALED" and match computed payload hash.

scope: Append-only immutable command capsules, RFC-8785 canonical payload hashing, and tamper-evident sealing.
title: Synthesis Command Capsule and Cryptographic Seal Contract
